q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT F.FOLLOWEE FOLLOWER, COUNT( DISTINCT F.FOLLOWER) NUM FROM FOLLOW F INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) FWR ON FWR.FOLLOWER = F.FOLLOWEE GROUP BY F.FOLLOWEE ORDER BY 1 ASC

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 counts the number of followers for each followee, while Q2 counts the number of distinct followers for each followee. The difference arises when a followee has multiple followers with the same follower ID.
